name: Immerguest: The Veiled Inn
description:
About This Game

ENTER THE VEILED INN

Beyond the mist lies an inn that should not be there.

IMMERGUEST – The Veiled Inn is a dark turn-based party RPG built around tactical combat, build-shaping choices and branching journeys through a mysterious world beyond the inn.

Choose your path, face dangerous encounters and strengthen your party as you push deeper into the unknown.

BUILD YOUR FLOW

Repeating the same attack will only get you so far.

Using different actions in succession builds Flow, rewarding players who constantly adapt instead of relying on a single powerful move.

Chain together Basic Actions and Skills to build momentum and complete the sequence with a devastating Flow Strike.

Basic Actions also generate Overflow — temporary Mana that can be spent before your regular Mana, giving you another resource to manage as each fight develops.

Change your rhythm. Build your Flow. Finish the chain.

ENEMY TURNS AREN'T JUST SOMETHING YOU WATCH

Many enemy attacks can be avoided with precisely timed dodges.

Watch your opponent, react during the dodge window and avoid incoming damage.

Some attacks strike several times in succession, forcing you to read the entire sequence and time multiple dodges correctly.

Every action matters — even when it is not your turn.

FIGHT AS A PARTY

Take control of three distinct heroes, each with their own abilities and combat identity.

Haldor fights on the front line, breaking defenses, weakening enemies and protecting his allies.

Selena overwhelms targets with speed, rapid attacks, Marks and powerful multi-hit abilities.

Lyria commands fire, ice and arcane magic to control the battlefield and devastate groups of enemies.

Every hero builds their own Flow, turning party management, action choice and turn order into an important part of every encounter.

SHAPE EVERY JOURNEY

Your party grows stronger throughout each run.

After battles, discover Mods that alter and strengthen individual abilities, opening new combinations and strategies as the journey continues.

Before setting out, seek guidance at the Veiled Inn and choose a Tarot card that grants a powerful effect for the run ahead.

Your build develops during the journey — and the choices you make determine how your party fights when the next major challenge awaits.

CHOOSE YOUR PATH THROUGH THE MIST

Travel across branching paths filled with battles, dangerous elite encounters, strange events and places of respite.

Decide where to go, when to take a risk and how far you can push your party into the unknown.

Every route presents different choices, dangers and opportunities to shape your run.

RETURN TO THE INN

The Veiled Inn is more than a menu between journeys.

Speak with its inhabitants, prepare your party, seek guidance from the Tarot or sharpen your skills through an interactive combat tutorial.

The inn is a place of refuge.

But beneath its warmth and familiarity lies a mystery waiting to be uncovered.

Why does the inn stand beyond the mist?

And why does leaving it never seem as simple as walking through the door?

FACE WHAT WAITS BEYOND THE MIST

The deeper you travel, the more dangerous the world becomes.

Learn enemy patterns, refine your party, shape your abilities through Mods and prepare for challenging encounters that put your understanding of Flow, timing and party composition to the test.

Every journey demands adaptation.

Every battle is another step into the unknown.

FEATURES

  • The mysterious Veiled Inn as your central hub

  • Three playable heroes with distinct combat styles

  • Tactical turn-based combat with real-time dodge mechanics

  • Flow, Flow Strikes and Overflow

  • Individual Flow management for every party member

  • Skill Mods that shape your build throughout each run

  • Tarot cards with powerful run-changing effects

  • Branching paths with battles, elite encounters and events

  • Multi-hit attacks requiring precisely timed dodges

  • A variety of enemies and challenging boss encounters

  • An interactive combat tutorial integrated into the Veiled Inn

  • A dark fantasy world built around the mysteries beyond the mist

Your stay at the Veiled Inn has only just begun.
short_desc: Immerguest: The Veiled Inn is a dark fantasy roguelite strategy RPG with turn-based tactical combat, active dodge timing, and powerful relic and mod builds. Choose your path, manage Mana and Overflow, and survive the cursed inn’s deadly loop.
